description: Buy a multi-level upgrade on an owned (or FSODonated) object, raising its upgrade level and resetting wear. Prerequisite: you are the owner of the target object (handler-side VMTSOObjectState.OwnerID gate). target_upgrade_level must exceed the object's current UpgradeLevel (server rejects otherwise). Skill-gated on the server side via VMNetUpgradeCmd.Verify which calls Content.Upgrades.GetUpgradePrice; the upgrade transaction runs through GlobalLink.PerformTransaction against your funds before the command is re-forwarded with Verified=true. Effect: object's UpgradeLevel advances to target_upgrade_level, wear resets, VMEventType.TSOUpgraded fires, object's InitialPrice increases by AddedValue. Cost: the upgrade price from your budget (depends on object and level). Wire: VMNetUpgradeCmd on the lot Aries socket.
